description: Title composition for the document head. The renderer always emits a <title> element plus the default description meta. A supplied page title is, by default, combined with the configured site/default title using a separator (page title first, then separator, then default). Callers may opt out of appending the default to render the page title verbatim, may override the separator, or may change the default title itself; when no explicit page title is given the default title is rendered alone.
